en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father from al-Saqr b. Dulf. He said:

I asked Abu’l Hasan `Ali b. Muhammad b. `Ali b. Musa al-Rida (as) about monotheism, and I said that I take the doctrine of Hisham b. al-Hakam. So, he (as) became angry and said: What is with you and the doctrine of Hisham? Whoever alleges that Allah is a body is not of us, and we dissociate from him in this world and the Hereafter. O Ibn Dulf! Surely, a body is generated, and Allah is its generator and its maker.
